owner_request: Animate all five latest characters for camp; find a distinct action for Shade while Whisperer levitates.

request.description: Keep this exact inhuman muscular general: same proportionate large ridged head, face, pearl-grey skin, obsidian forearm growths, black clothing and ancient gold. Change ONLY his camp work pose and add functional blacksmith gear. One full-body front sprite, standing grounded behind a small squat dark obsidian anvil in the lower centre. His right hand holds a short heavy angular forging hammer above the anvil ready for a measured strike; left hand holds a pair of dark tongs keeping a small blunt metal workpiece on the anvil. Hammer and tongs must read clearly, no weapon swing or battle pose. Anvil has simple broad flat top and pedestal, muted antique gold metalwork. Calm absolute command, concentration, chest stays broad and head readable. Keep character recognisably identical, no new helmet, no robe, no neon. Entire sprite AND anvil and hammer inside transparent 192x192 canvas with 8px margin; retain heroic proportions and crisp pixel clusters. No text, floor, scenery, extra characters or flames.

Keep the same stout alien patriarch: exact flared ridged cranial anatomy, amused gentle uncle face, grey-violet nacre skin, grown obsidian and gold augments, black regalia, reduced rounded abdomen from this source. Change his pose to RECLINING ASLEEP for camp. Heavy relaxed body resting low in a wide reclining posture, upper body propped against one elbow on a low black obsidian bolster, head gently tipped sideways, both eyes closed, mouth relaxed with tiny contented smile, one free hand resting on his body augmentation. Legs folded naturally to one side, all limbs intact. His silhouette reads sleepy carefree alien uncle, NOT a dead body, not a slug, not Jabba copied, not a huge spherical belly. Same face and materials, keep fully clothed hip regalia. Entire reclined body inside transparent 192x192 frame with 8px margin, detailed coherent pixel art. No text, z letters, floor, background, other characters or additional furniture.

Preserve this exact alien astral scholar's elongated ridged head, eyes, facial identity, lavender nacre skin, black embodied membranes, sparse ancient gold, covered chest and two arms. Change only camp pose to deliberate STUDYING AND TRACING ORDERS. She levitates quietly with lower legs loosely folded beneath her, posture upright and thoughtful rather than dancing. Three small separated dark obsidian tablet fragments float in a shallow arc in front of her chest and waist, etched with restrained muted old-gold short line marks. One hand points a precise index finger at the nearest tablet; other hand gently steadies a lower fragment. Clearly reads scholar sorting and tracing instructions. No book, hood, conventional magician robe, wand, bright symbols, halo, neon or circular magic portal. This activity must differ from a woman simply hovering or waving a veil. Same individual, fully covered breasts, all limbs intact. Entire character and tablets inside transparent 192x192 frame with 8px margin, front facing, same crisp pixel style and subdued palette. No text, scene, floor or other people.
